data.credibility: Titan's management frequently drops previously stated guidance and store expansion targets without providing subsequent updates or actual delivery figures across later quarters, indicating a pattern of unmonitored promises except for one recently pending store expansion goal.

lines.line: Promised mid-teen EBIT margin for watches in FY26, but the target was later dropped.
Guided 11% to 11.5% company EBIT margin for FY26, but dropped the target.
Targeted 35 to 40 new Tanishq stores in FY26, but the goal was dropped.
Planned 70 to 80 store expansions and renovations for the year, but dropped it.
Targeted 13% to 14% eyewear growth for FY26, but later dropped the guidance.
Promised beYon LGD platform expansion to 10 to 12 stores, currently pending.
